solution:
**Formula used:**

S.P. = (100 + P%) × C.P. 

Where, S.P. = Selling price

P% = Profit percentage 

C.P. = Cost price 

**Calculation:**

This question we will solve by options

**On considering option (1), we have **

⇒ Cost price of refrigerators = Rs. 48000 

⇒ Cost price after 10% increase = 48000 × (110)/(100) = Rs. 52,800 

⇒ Also, profit% = 22% 

⇒ So, S.P. = (100 + P%) × C.P. 

⇒ S.P. = (122)/(100) × 52800 = Rs. 64,416 

**On considering option (2), we have**

⇒ Cost price of music systems = Rs. 65000 

⇒ Cost price after 10% increase = 65000 × (110)/(100) = Rs. 71,500 

⇒ Profit% = 18% 

⇒ S.P. = (100 + 18%) × 71500 

⇒ (118)/(100) × 71500 = Rs. 84,370 

**On considering option (3), we have**

⇒ Cost price of air conditioners = Rs. 39000 

⇒ Cost price after 10% increase = 39000 × (110)/(100) = Rs. 42,900 

⇒ Profit% = 17% 

⇒ S.P. = (117)/(100) × 42900 = Rs. 50,193 

**On considering option (4), we have**

⇒ Cost price of televisions = Rs. 59000

⇒ Cost price after 10% increase = 59000 × (110)/(100) = Rs. 64,900 

⇒ Profit% = 23%

⇒ S.P. = (123)/(100) × 64,900 = Rs. 79,827

It is clear that the music system has a maximum increase in sales price

**⇒ ****Hence, Option 2 is correct.**
